_about: Sixty (US) copy — edit freely, keep the keys. pillars: the 60 day signs; stems: element, image, traits; themes: what a day means, by its Ten God and tone (xi = the day's element fuels you, ji = it drains you; neutral uses xi); tenGods: [friendly name, classical name]; levels: the five day levels; seasons: the 24 solar terms; pairKinds/pairs: friend paintings; elements: colors and what fuels you. Art lives in ../art/.

pillars.name: Oak by Winter Water
pillars.intro: Bookish and easy to like. Every new thing you learn makes you surer of yourself.

pillars.name: Plum Blossom in Snow
pillars.intro: Tough, patient and practical. You bloom in the cold, when everyone else has gone quiet.

pillars.name: Sunrise in the Spring Woods
pillars.intro: Curious, upbeat and full of energy. You bring the morning with you wherever you go.

pillars.name: Lantern on a Flowering Branch
pillars.intro: Imaginative, with a look all your own. Even when you're quiet, you give off light.

pillars.name: Mountain with a Hidden Spring
pillars.intro: Steady and generous. You can hold a lot — problems, secrets, people — and keep it all safe.

pillars.name: Sunny Fields in Early Summer
pillars.intro: Warm, lively and resourceful. You meet things head-on and usually find a way.

pillars.name: Sword Tempered in Summer Fire
pillars.intro: Polished and principled. You keep your standards, and pressure only makes you sharper.

pillars.name: Gem in the Sand
pillars.intro: Calm and seasoned on the outside, finely tuned on the inside. You notice everything.

pillars.name: River Rushing from Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Quick-minded with real staying power. You learn fast, and your world keeps getting wider.

pillars.name: Dew on an Autumn Morning
pillars.intro: Clear-headed with sharp instincts. You get things done cleanly, without fuss.

pillars.name: Tree on an Autumn Ridge
pillars.intro: Down-to-earth and low-key, with deep reserves. People feel safe around you.

pillars.name: Blossoms on a Winter Lake
pillars.intro: Kind, intuitive and calm inside. You never push, and you still carry weight.

pillars.name: Sunrise over a Frozen Lake
pillars.intro: Upright and gracious. You play fair — and you can warm up the coldest room.

pillars.name: Lamplight in a Snowy Window
pillars.intro: Unflashy, with a plan you keep to yourself. Your life runs on quiet good judgment.

pillars.name: Mountain in the Spring Forest
pillars.intro: A commanding presence, born to lead. When it counts, you make the call.

pillars.name: Field of Spring Sprouts
pillars.intro: Busy on the surface, calm underneath. The more there is to do, the more organized you get.

pillars.name: Sword Rising from a Spring Lake
pillars.intro: Strong presence, a mind of your own. The harder it gets, the more you want to win.

pillars.name: Gem on a Sun-Warmed Stone
pillars.intro: Gracious and easy to like. You weigh things carefully — sometimes twice, sometimes ten times.

pillars.name: Lake Holding the Summer Sky
pillars.intro: Bright and easygoing. You know how to build a good life, and everyone around you feels it.

pillars.name: Rain on Dry Ground
pillars.intro: Big-hearted and giving. When you help, you help exactly where it matters.

pillars.name: Tree on a Windy Cliff
pillars.intro: Disciplined and decisive. Pressure makes you better — you stand tall and hold your ground.

pillars.name: Osmanthus under the Autumn Moon
pillars.intro: Precise and composed. Your craft shows in the details.

pillars.name: Sun Setting into Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Grounded and deep. Your warmth shows up in what you do, not in what you say.

pillars.name: Lantern on a Winter River
pillars.intro: Honest and reserved. You're quiet, and people trust you anyway — instantly.

pillars.name: Mountain on a Snowy Night
pillars.intro: Practical, steady, smart with money. The higher the stakes, the more reliable you get.

pillars.name: Field Resting in Winter
pillars.intro: Humble and practical, a natural at living well. You know what's worth keeping.

pillars.name: Sword in Stone, Spring Woods
pillars.intro: A sharp eye for opportunity. Once you see it, you move.

pillars.name: Jade Hairpin among Flowers
pillars.intro: Elegant and nimble-minded. You're always first to spot an opening.

pillars.name: Ocean at Spring Tide
pillars.intro: Big presence, big ambitions. Rough water just gets you going.

pillars.name: Sunshower in Early Summer
pillars.intro: Gentle and thoughtful. People are drawn to you, and you're easy to be around.

pillars.name: Tree on a Summer Plain
pillars.intro: Clever and magnetic. People notice you, and your ideas are usually a step ahead.

pillars.name: Vine on Late-Summer Earth
pillars.intro: Grounded and results-minded. You can put down roots anywhere.

pillars.name: Sun on an Autumn Evening
pillars.intro: Quick and perceptive. You read the room, and you're funny without overstepping.

pillars.name: Candle in an Autumn Window
pillars.intro: Refined taste and a nose for opportunity. You know how to live.

pillars.name: Mountain in Late Autumn
pillars.intro: Solid and quiet. You keep your word — you're the one everyone counts on.

pillars.name: Field by Early Winter Water
pillars.intro: Steady and fair, with a fine sense of proportion. You can adapt to almost anything.

pillars.name: Sword in a Cold Spring
pillars.intro: Bright and lively. There's a spark in how you talk and work, and new ideas keep coming.

pillars.name: Uncut Jade in Winter Earth
pillars.intro: You don't say much, but you see deep — into people, and into things.

pillars.name: River through the Spring Woods
pillars.intro: Talented and fun-loving. You know how to enjoy life, and the ideas never stop.

pillars.name: Spring Dew
pillars.intro: Fresh and quick-witted. Your talent hides in the details, and you always know where the line is.

pillars.name: Oak on a Rainy Riverbank
pillars.intro: You think big and give freely. Every year, you stand on firmer ground.

pillars.name: Flower Climbing the Rocks
pillars.intro: Bright and expressive. Walk into a room, and you're seen.

pillars.name: Midsummer Noon Sun
pillars.intro: Warm, bold and quick to act. Your energy fills the place.

pillars.name: Lamp on a Country Path
pillars.intro: Reliable and steady. If you say it, you'll do it.

pillars.name: Autumn Hill with a Clear Spring
pillars.intro: Witty and playful, with a real gift for enjoying life.

pillars.name: Fields at Harvest
pillars.intro: You know good things when you see them. Your life has real flavor.

pillars.name: Old Sword in the Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Plain-spoken and quiet, with principles you won't bend. People rely on you.

pillars.name: Pearl in a Winter Lake
pillars.intro: Graceful and perceptive, with a real creative streak.

pillars.name: Ocean Rising on a Winter Night
pillars.intro: Bold and fearless, and loyal to the core.

pillars.name: Drizzle on Winter Fields
pillars.intro: Quiet and low-key, with a mind firmly your own. You carry weight without making noise.

pillars.name: Great Tree in the Early Spring Forest
pillars.intro: Confident and sure of yourself. You were made to grow upward.

pillars.name: Orchid after Spring Rain
pillars.intro: Fresh, lovely and easy to be around. People are simply drawn to you.

pillars.name: Sun Breaking through Rain Clouds
pillars.intro: Gentle and cultured, with a head full of wonderful ideas.

pillars.name: Kiln Fire in Early Summer
pillars.intro: You don't give up, and your drive is contagious.

pillars.name: High Mountain under Blazing Sun
pillars.intro: Passionate and strong under pressure. You stand out wherever you go.

pillars.name: Golden Wheat in Late Summer
pillars.intro: Hardworking and never one to quit. Step by step, you build a full life.

pillars.name: Sword on an Autumn Cliff
pillars.intro: Direct, unbreakable, and fiercely loyal.

pillars.name: Diamond under the Autumn Moon
pillars.intro: Exacting, with high standards — and fiercely loyal to your people.

pillars.name: Lake Ringed by Autumn Hills
pillars.intro: Kind-hearted, intuitive, and very good with money.

pillars.name: Fine Rain on a Winter Lake
pillars.intro: Calm on the surface, with real depth of heart and vision.

5.line: One of your best days. Go for it.

4.line: Things flow. A good day to move forward.

3.line: An even day. Keep a normal pace.

2.line: Some friction. Double-check and go slow.

1.line: Keep it simple. Rest and skip big moves.

xi.title: A Day for Recognition
xi.line: Structure works for you. Bosses, rules and reputation are on your side.
do: Show your work to someone senior
Follow the process — it pays off

ji.title: A Day of Expectations
ji.line: Other people's expectations weigh more than usual. Meet them, but don't twist yourself to fit.

xi.title: A Day to Push Through
xi.line: Pressure turns into drive. You can move something big today.
dont: Waste the momentum on small stuff

ji.title: A High-Pressure Day
ji.line: Pressure is high and patience is thin. Pace yourself and pick your battles.

xi.title: A Day to Be Supported
xi.line: Good for learning, resting and letting people help you.
do: Read, study or take a class

ji.title: A Slow, Heavy Day
ji.line: Comfort pulls at you and things move slowly. Rest is fine — just don't stall on what matters.
do: Do one thing you've been putting off

xi.title: A Day for Deep Thinking
xi.line: Your mind wants quiet. Good for research, strategy and time alone.
do: Block two hours of focus time

ji.title: A Restless, Inward Day
ji.line: You may feel out of sync with people. Keep to yourself a little, and don't read too much into things.
do: Write it down before you say it
dont: Make big decisions on a hunch

xi.title: A Day for Allies
xi.line: Friends and teammates have your back. Collaborate.
do: Team up on a shared project
Reach out to an old friend
dont: Go it alone out of pride

ji.title: A Crowded Day
ji.line: Everyone wants a piece of the same thing. Share the credit, guard your time.
do: Be clear about who does what

xi.title: A Competitive Day
xi.line: A little rivalry sharpens you. Go after it — and play fair.

ji.title: A Day to Guard Your Wallet
ji.line: Spending and rivalry run high. Stay sharp and watch your money.

xi.title: A Day of Ease
xi.line: Relaxed and creative. Make something you enjoy.
do: Say yes to a small pleasure

ji.title: A Lazy-Feeling Day
ji.line: Comfort is tempting and focus is soft. Enjoy it, but finish one real thing.
do: Pick one task and finish it

xi.title: A Day to Speak Up
xi.line: Ideas are flowing and you want to be heard. Go for it.

ji.title: A Day to Mind Your Words
ji.line: You'll want to say exactly what you think. Say it kindly — or sleep on it.

xi.title: A Payoff Day
xi.line: Steady effort pays off. Good for money and practical work.

ji.title: A Day of Small Leaks
ji.line: Money and time slip away in small ways. Keep a tight grip on the details.
do: Say no to one extra commitment

xi.title: A Lucky-Break Day
xi.line: Unexpected chances and connections show up. Stay open.
do: Network, or say yes to an invite

ji.title: A Day of Temptations
ji.line: Shiny offers and easy money call. Most aren't what they seem today.
do: Ask one more question before saying yes
dont: Spend the windfall before it lands

Wood.fuels: Growth and fresh starts: plants, morning walks, learning something new.

Fire.fuels: Warmth and energy: sunlight, movement, being around people.

Earth.fuels: Stability: routines, cooking, home, steady habits.

Metal.fuels: Clarity: decluttering, clear rules, crisp air, finishing things.

Water.fuels: Rest and depth: sleep, reading, water, quiet time.

strength.strong: You run strong: plenty of your own element. You do best when you spend that energy — create, earn, take on structure.
strength.weak: You run gentle: you rely on support. You do best with rest, learning and people who have your back.

match.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. Your signs combine — together, you both feel more like yourselves.

same.text: You are both the {me}. Same instincts, same rhythm — the kind of pair that goes the distance.

lift.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. You hold them up, and they give your care somewhere to go.

lifted.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. They hold you up — around them, you stand a little taller.

push.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. You push them forward. When it grinds, give them room.

pushed.text: You are the {me}, they are the {you}. They push you forward. Get through the friction, and no one will know you better.
